svg.title: Chemist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as chemist, wearing a protective coat and protective goggles. Visible work cue: A conical flask has a narrow neck and a clear liquid line beside a separate long stirring rod. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: protective goggles.
